scope_note: Vendredi n°234, dated 24 June 1994 on its pages. Imported: the report on the Conseil national of 19 June 1994 that voted its no-confidence in Michel Rocard and elected Henri Emmanuelli (PDF p. 4, 7 and 8). An issue of the Parti socialiste's weekly, a party record for its own offices, as digitized and served by the Fondation Jean-Jaurès's Centre d'archives socialistes (the party's foundation archive). The stored PDF is the file the archive's public document viewer loads for this catalogue record; its OCR text layer was read and quotations are kept to passages whose OCR reads cleanly.

rows.text: The issue reports that the Conseil national of 19 June 1994 'a tranché en votant majoritairement sa défiance à Michel Rocard', and records a debate 'sur la procédure à suivre pour remplacer la direction démissionnaire'.

rows.text: The issue reports: 'Le Conseil National du 19 juin a élu Henri Emmanuelli premier secrétaire du Parti socialiste.'

locator.item: article 'Henri Emmanuelli Premier secrétaire', first sentence

rows.text: Describing the congress to follow, the same issue writes that it 'n'a d'extraordinaire que la date', as 'a précisé le premier secrétaire' Henri Emmanuelli, who 'entend confirmer son élection par le Conseil national dans un vote des militants et des délégués au congrès'.
